description: Find an external service that can complete an outcome your current tools cannot — data lookups, media transformations and other real-world tasks, free or pay-per-use. Returns a small candidate set with evidence-grounded match reasons, price, latency and status. It never charges and never writes external state. On this hosted gateway, free reads are executable; capabilities that write external state are marked invocable_here:false.

max_price_usd.description: Drop paid capabilities above this fixed USD price

media_type.description: Require this media type in the contract, e.g. 'image/png'

payment_modes.description: Payment methods the buyer can actually present

query.description: The intended outcome in natural language, e.g. 'convert USD to EUR'

name: search_capabilities

available_capabilities.description: Only when results is empty: every active capability

related_routes.description: Only when results is empty: routes (agent field guides) that match the query instead

results.description: Candidates, best first. Empty when nothing matched.

invocable_here.description: Executable on this hosted read-only gateway
